edges.reason: tx.origin is used as the mapping key that records the last transfer block for the launch delay.
_transfer reads tx.origin to enforce only one purchase per block per origin.
block.timestamp is stored into lastLpBurnTime.
enableTrading depends on block.timestamp to seed LP burn scheduling.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens compares block.timestamp with lastLpBurnTime plus lpBurnFrequency.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens requires block.timestamp to exceed lastManualLpBurnTime plus cooldown.
_transfer gates automatic LP burn on block.timestamp >= lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency.
constructor mints the entire total supply to msg.sender.
_transfer calls swapBack, which performs external ETH transfers while swapping is set.
_transfer triggers autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens which makes an external pair.sync() call.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert accumulated tokens into ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity to deposit the liquidity share.
constructor marks the newly created uniswap pair as an automated market maker pair.
constructor excludes the router and pair from max transaction limits.
constructor excludes owner, contract and dead address from fees.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private helper.
swapBack sends ETH to devWallet through a low-level call whose success flag is ignored.
swapBack sweeps the remaining ETH to marketingWallet through a low-level call.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router fee-on-transfer swap with zero minimum output.
addLiquidity invokes router addLiquidityETH with zero slippage minimums.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the external pair contract.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the external pair contract.
devWallet is the destination address of the low-level ETH call in swapBack.
marketingWallet is the destination address of the final low-level ETH sweep.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to classify buys, sells and wallet transfers.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to waive fees and launch restrictions.
_transfer reads and writes the swapping reentrancy guard.
_transfer checks limitsInEffect before applying caps and delays.
_transfer requires tradingActive for non-excluded accounts.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before calling swapBack.
_transfer checks transferDelayEnabled before the tx.origin delay logic.
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buys and sells.
_transfer enforces maxWallet on recipient balances.
_transfer uses buyTotalFees to compute the fee taken on buys.
_transfer uses sellTotalFees to compute the fee taken on sells.
_transfer accumulates token fees into tokensForMarketing using multiplication and division.
_transfer accumulates token fees into tokensForLiquidity using multiplication and division.
_transfer accumulates token fees into tokensForDev using multiplication and division.
_transfer checks lpBurnEnabled before triggering the automatic burn.
_transfer adds lpBurnFrequency to lastLpBurnTime for the timestamp comparison.
swapBack caps the contract balance using swapTokensAtAmount.
swapBack uses tokensForMarketing to compute the marketing ETH share.
swapBack uses tokensForLiquidity to compute the liquidity token share.
swapBack uses tokensForDev to compute the dev ETH share.
swapTokensForEth routes the swap through uniswapV2Router.
addLiquidity routes the liquidity deposit through uniswapV2Router.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads the token balance of uniswapV2Pair.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads the token balance of uniswapV2Pair.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens overwrites lastLpBurnTime with block.timestamp.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens uses percentForLPBurn to size the burn.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens updates lastManualLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens uses manualBurnFrequency for the cooldown requirement.
updateMarketingWallet rewrites the marketingWallet address.
updateDevWallet rewrites the devWallet address.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
removeLimits sets limitsInEffect to false.
disableTransferDelay sets transferDelayEnabled to false.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount rewrites swapTokensAtAmount within bounds.
updateMaxTxnAmount rewrites maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount rewrites maxWallet.
excludeFromFees rewrites the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
updateBuyFees rewrites buyTotalFees and the buy fee components.
updateSellFees rewrites sellTotalFees and the sell fee components.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair rewrites the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping.
from parameter is the source address consumed by _transfer.
to parameter is the destination address consumed by _transfer.
amount parameter is subtracted and split into fees inside _transfer.
percent parameter scales the burn amount in manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from is only meaningful as the source argument of _transfer.
Parameter to is only meaningful as the destination argument of _transfer.
Parameter amount is the value processed by the _transfer fee arithmetic.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary read of the contract balance inside _transfer.
canSwap is a transient decision flag inside _transfer.
takeFee is a transient decision flag inside _transfer.
fees is a temporary computed value used by _transfer.
Parameter percent only scales the burn amount in manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
amountToBurn is a temporary computed value inside manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
liquidityPairBalance is a temporary balance read inside manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
totalTokensToSwap is a temporary sum used only for the swapBack split.
contractBalance is a temporary capped balance used only inside swapBack.
amountToSwapForETH is a temporary computed value passed to the swap in swapBack.
